profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as offering trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare sector. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates as an independent entity serving healthcare providers, life sciences organizations, and payers. Its portfolio spans clinical decision support, clinical data management, enterprise imaging, cardiovascular workflow tools, health data analytics, and real-world evidence solutions.

Among its named products, Micromedex provides clinical decision support at the point of care, while Zelta is a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed for clinical trials programs. The Merge suite covers enterprise imaging and workflow tools including Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo described as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked. Truven delivers health data analytics and consulting services, and the company also offers a portfolio focused on real-world evidence studies. Customer-reported outcomes cited on the site include a jump from a 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort.

The site's held facts categorize Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, noting capabilities in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
